steps.title: Fire and light
steps.body: Vines that burn away, torch stands to light, bombs that break cracked walls, and beams of light that mirrors turn onto a sensor: they are under Starter pack › Fire and light, and each works by itself.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: Vines, a torch and a torch stand
steps.body: Place Vines across the way 6 studs in front of the start, a Hand torch just to the left of the start, and a Torch stand ahead to the right. The Hand torch is the Torch item: picked up, it goes into an item button.
steps.task: Place Vines, a Hand torch and a Torch stand.

steps.title: Burn the vines
steps.body: Press Play and walk over the Hand torch: it goes into item button 1 (J). Vines can be climbed: walk into them and keep walking, and the hero climbs up (W up, S down, Space lets go). Then stand in front of them and press J: a flame sets them alight, and they burn away in two seconds. Vines touching them catch too.
steps.task: Press Play, take the torch and burn the vines.

steps.title: Light the torch stand
steps.body: Walk to the torch stand and press J again: it lights and stays lit. A torch stand only answers fire, so a sword does nothing to it. A Timed torch goes out again after its seconds; Light all the torches (Scripts and cutscenes) opens a gate when they all burn.
steps.task: Light the torch stand with the torch.

steps.title: A cracked wall and a bomb flower
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Cracked wall to the left of the start, and a Bomb flower in front of it, a few studs away. Only an explosion breaks a cracked wall. The flower grows a bomb; if a bomb misses, it grows another.
steps.task: Place a Cracked wall and a Bomb flower.

steps.title: Blow it up
steps.body: Press Play. Walk up to the Bomb flower and press E (Pick up): the hero lifts a lit bomb over its head. Throw it at the wall with F (the Attack button says Throw), or carry it to the wall and put it down with E, then step back. It goes off after 4 seconds and the wall breaks. Missed? The flower grows a new bomb: try again. (A Bomb bag gives bombs for an item button instead: K lifts one, K or F throws it.)
steps.task: Press Play, pick a bomb from the flower and break the wall.

steps.title: A beam, a mirror and a sensor
steps.body: Stop the game. About 9 studs ahead of the start, off to the right: place a Mirror 12 studs right of the way the start looks, and a Sun crest 8 studs to its left, turned (T) so it shines right into the mirror. Put a Light sensor 6 studs beyond the mirror (further from the start). The beam is a bright yellow line at waist height, running straight from the crest until something stops it.
steps.task: Place a Sun crest, a Mirror and a Light sensor ahead and to the right.

steps.title: Turn the mirror
steps.body: Press Play. To see the whole puzzle, drag up in the play view to look down from above, and scroll to zoom out. The beam crosses from the crest into the mirror, and the mirror sends it back toward you, away from the sensor. Walk up to the mirror (from any side) and press Action (E · Turn): it leans the other way, the beam turns on past the mirror onto the sensor, and the sensor lights up gold. Wire it to a gate with Switch opens a gate.
steps.task: Press Play and turn the mirror until the sensor lights.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You burned vines and lit a torch stand with the Torch, blew up a cracked wall with a bomb, and turned a mirror to bring a beam of light onto a sensor. Make your own in the Asset studio: Fire and light › Burns, Shines a beam, Mirror; a switch Lit by a beam, or Hit by Fire.
